001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.net.URI;
004import java.net.URISyntaxException;
005import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
006
007import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.PropertyProblem;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.Result;
011
012/**
013 * Log LogProvider Source.
014 */
015public sealed interface LogProviderRef {
016
017        /**
018         * URI of the log provider.
019         * @return uri not <code>null</code>.
020         */
021        URI uri();
022
023        /**
024         * Property key from where the URI came from or <code>null</code>.
025         * @return property key.
026         */
027        @Nullable String keyOrNull();
028
029        /**
030         * Creates a log provider ref from URI.
031         * @param uri uri.
032         * @return ref.
033         */
034        public static LogProviderRef of(URI uri) {
035                return new DefaultLogProviderRef(uri, null);
036        }
037
038        /**
039         * Create a provider ref from a property result.
040         * @param property successful URI result.
041         * @return provider ref.
042         */
043        public static LogProviderRef of(Result.Success<? extends URI> property) {
044                return new DefaultLogProviderRef(property.value(), property.key());
045        }
046
047        /**
048         * Creates a log provider ref from URI.
049         * @param uri uri.
050         * @param key property key where URI came from.
051         * @return ref.
052         */
053        public static LogProviderRef of(URI uri, @Nullable String key) {
054                return new DefaultLogProviderRef(uri, key);
055        }
056
057        /**
058         * Thrown if a provider could not be found for the ref.
059         */
060        public static final class NotFoundException extends NoSuchElementException implements PropertyProblem {
061
062                private static final long serialVersionUID = 5484668688480940159L;
063
064                NotFoundException(String s) {
065                        super(s);
066                }
067
068                @Override
069                public String errorName() {
070                        return "NotFoundException";
071                }
072
073                /**
074                 * Builds a {@link NotFoundException} for an unregistered scheme, with a message
075                 * consistent across every kind of provider registry (output/publisher/encoder/
076                 * etc). If the scheme happens to be one known to be provided by an optional
077                 * module not currently on the classpath (see {@link ProviderModule}), the message
078                 * is extended to say which dependency to add.
079                 * @param component the kind of thing not found.
080                 * @param scheme the URI scheme that had no provider registered for it.
081                 * @param uri the full URI that was being resolved.
082                 * @return exception, not thrown.
083                 */
084                static NotFoundException of(ProviderModule.ComponentType component, String scheme, URI uri) {
085                        String message = "No " + component.label() + " found. Scheme not registered. scheme: '" + scheme
086                                        + "', URI: '" + uri + "'";
087                        var module = ProviderModule.find(component, scheme);
088                        if (module.isPresent()) {
089                                var m = module.get();
090                                message += ". Scheme '" + scheme + "' is provided by module '" + m.moduleName() + "' (Maven: '"
091                                                + m.mavenGav() + "') - add that dependency.";
092                        }
093                        return new NotFoundException(message);
094                }
095
096        }
097
098}
099
100record DefaultLogProviderRef(URI uri, @Nullable String keyOrNull) implements LogProviderRef {
101        static URI normalize(URI uri) {
102                String scheme = uri.getScheme();
103                String path = uri.getPath();
104                try {
105                        if (scheme == null) {
106                                if (path == null) {
107                                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("URI is not proper: " + uri);
108                                }
109                                uri = new URI(path + ":///");
110                                if (uri.getScheme() == null) {
111                                        /*
112                                         * A leading "/" or "." keeps the URI parser from ever attempting
113                                         * scheme detection, so appending ":///" above silently produces
114                                         * another scheme-less URI instead of throwing. Fail clearly here
115                                         * rather than letting an unresolvable URI reach a provider registry.
116                                         */
117                                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("URI is not proper: " + uri);
118                                }
119                        }
120                }
121                catch (URISyntaxException e) {
122                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("URI is not proper: " + uri);
123                }
124                return uri;
125        }
126
127        static LogProviderRef normalize(LogProviderRef ref) {
128                var uri = ref.uri();
129                uri = DefaultLogProviderRef.normalize(uri);
130                return new DefaultLogProviderRef(uri, ref.keyOrNull());
131        }
132}
